description: The company's own Nomid plan (FREE, PRO or ENTERPRISE), its term and billing cadence, its device limit (the Free plan's; paid plans have none), how many devices count as billable now and which devices count, and whether anything blocks new enrollments. The device limit never blocks enrollment: devices above it still enroll and count. Use it before any claim about this company's plan, limit or billable devices. No prices: for list prices use search_nomid_site; the company's invoices are on the Billing page (portalUrl).

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

name: get_company_plan
title: Get the company's plan
